function.name: create_callback_request
function.description: Ask the office to call the caller back: a tool failed, they want a person and transfer isn't available, they want to reschedule or cancel, they speak another language, a building-wide system needs office review, they're out of area but think we misheard, or the call can't be finished.

details.description: Short summary of what the caller needs.

phone.description: Best callback number if different from caller ID.

language.description: Caller's language if not English, e.g. 'Spanish', so the office calls back in it.

context.description: Anything useful already collected (address, issue, chosen window).

messages.content: One moment, I'm setting up a callback.
Let me get that callback request in.
